author: r. g. sun
title: UMass Lowell women's lacrosse defeats Central Michigan 15-6
text:
The UMass Lowell women’s lacrosse team earned a 15-6 win over Central Michigan on March 17 at Cushing Field. Junior Bronwyn Hilbert led the River Hawks with five goals in the game.
The victory brings UMass Lowell’s record to 4-5, while Central Michigan falls to 1-8. The result highlights a strong performance by the River Hawks, who saw nine different players contribute points during the match.
Head Coach Lisa Miller said, “I thought we started well. We started quickly, thought we did a good job on the draw control early, and buried some shots early to get the lead, which was fairly comfortable, so we could work some younger kids in. We did a nice job of executing the gameplan.”
Hilbert finished with three goals and two assists. Senior Macy Shultz added three goals and an assist, while freshman Brienne Brezynskie scored three times as well. Other contributors included senior Grace Lydon with two goals; redshirt freshman Chiara Pompei with a goal and an assist; senior Kaitlynn Anderson, sophomores Georgia Ruscitti and Coco Clopton each with one goal; and sophomore Gigi Gill with an assist.
UMass Lowell built an early lead by scoring five unanswered goals in the first quarter and extended their advantage throughout the game. The defense limited Central Michigan to just one goal in the first half.
The River Hawks will next play against UAlbany on Saturday, March 21 at John Fallon Field in Albany.
